subject: visual-arts
intro: Visual arts leads into the image-making trades: exhibiting and selling work as a fine artist, directing the visual for campaigns and screen, and the graphic, photographic and fashion crafts that surround them.

roles.title: Fine Artists, Including Painters, Sculptors, and Illustrators
roles.what: Create original artwork using any of a wide variety of media and techniques — painting, sculpture, illustration and craft — showing and selling work through galleries, commissions and clients.
roles.where: Unit 1's visual language of colour, tone, line, form and composition, the record-explore-develop portfolio cycle, and the five areas of study from painting to three-dimensional design are the fine artist's working method.

roles.title: Art Directors
roles.what: Formulate design concepts and presentation approaches for visual productions and media such as print, broadcasting, video and film, and direct the workers engaged in artwork and layout design.
roles.where: The develop strand — evaluating your own work, reviewing and editing — becomes directing others; the graphic communication area of study's typography and advertising topics are the visual language art directors set.

roles.title: Graphic Designers
roles.what: Design or create graphics to meet specific commercial or promotional needs, such as packaging, displays or logos, using a variety of media to achieve artistic or decorative effects.
roles.where: The graphic communication area of study — illustration, packaging design, advertising, typography — plus composition and colour relationships from the visual-language unit, is the designer's syllabus verbatim.

roles.title: Photographers
roles.what: Photograph people, landscapes, merchandise or other subjects, using lighting equipment to enhance a subject's appearance and editing software to produce finished images and prints.
roles.where: Photography is one of the five areas of study: observational recording, experimenting with media and processes, and refining outcomes — while composition, tone and perspective from unit 1 govern every frame.

roles.title: Fashion Designers
roles.what: Design clothing and accessories, creating original designs or adapting fashion trends for manufacture, presentation and the market.
roles.where: The textiles and fashion area of study — fashion design and illustration, costume design, screen printing, batik, surface pattern — is the craft base; media exploration and refinement drive each collection.
